name: comp-482
title: Expandable Rows Table
blurb: Table rows that expand to reveal additional details below.
description: Data table with expandable rows showing additional note content. First column has chevron toggle button. Only rows with notes are expandable. Includes row selection checkboxes.
use_when: Tables where users need to see optional details per row without navigating to a detail page.
avoid_when: When most rows have expandable content — the expand pattern becomes tedious, use a detail view instead.
a11y: Expand buttons have aria-expanded attribute. aria-labels describe what will expand/collapse. Sub-row content is a full-width cell.
